name: LCD_READ

frame.format: Eight pages of 128 columns. Bit 0 is the top pixel of each eight-pixel column.

request.byte6: Offset in units of eight bytes, 0 through 127.

success.byte10: Requested offset in units of eight bytes.
success.byte11: Payload bytes, 8 to 128, multiple of eight, bounded by the effective GATT value capacity and the remaining frame.

errors: Standard 12-byte reply with zero bytes 10 and 11.
acquisition: Start at offset zero to freeze the framebuffer. Request the next offset sequentially using a new sequence number. An exact repeat of the last request reuses its reply. Publish the image after exactly 1024 bytes. No input event or file transfer is required.
link: Only a locally enabled DE remote session advertising the capability can supply an image.
